name: SponsorsHelper
description: SponsorsHelper is a Docker image that solves CAPTCHAs and decrypts links for Quasarr. Runtime access requires an active monthly GitHub sponsorship. On first start, open the GitHub authorization URL from container logs and complete the auth flow. Sign up for https://2captcha.com/?from=27506687 and provide your API Key in the APIKEY_2CAPTCHA environment variable.

paths.name: Config folder
paths.description: Persistent SponsorsHelper state including cached GitHub auth token.

variables.name: Quasarr URL
variables.description: Local URL of Quasarr including protocol and port (for example http://192.168.0.1:8080).

variables.name: Quasarr API Key
variables.description: Required API key from Quasarr web UI under Show API Settings.

variables.name: 2Captcha API Key
variables.description: Required API key for 2Captcha service. https://2captcha.com/?from=27506687

variables.name: FlareSolverr URL
variables.description: Local URL of FlareSolverr endpoint (for example http://10.10.0.1:8191/v1).
